dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Toi, tu m’as volé mon rendez-vous ?

scenes.image_prompt: Lina leaning forward angrily at a restaurant table, Tarek looking surprised, colorful plates and wine glasses, question marks floating above heads
scenes.motion_prompt: Lina points finger, head shakes, Tarek leans back with raised eyebrows, plates shake slightly

dialogue.speaker: tarek
dialogue.text: Moi ? J’ai juste parlé du même projet.

scenes.image_prompt: Close-up on Lina and Tarek facing each other across table, steam coming from coffee cups, tense expressions

dialogue.speaker: tarek
dialogue.text: Attends, je suis pas ton concurrent.

scenes.image_prompt: Tarek raising both hands in defense, Lina crossing arms, restaurant background with soft lights
Amel arriving at table smiling, Lina and Tarek turning surprised, light bulb icon above Amel
scenes.motion_prompt: Amel sits down smoothly, light bulb pops and glows, Lina and Tarek heads turn fast

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: C’est toi qui m’as invitée via l’appli ?

scenes.image_prompt: Lina checking phone screen, Amel nodding, Tarek in background looking relieved

dialogue.speaker: tarek
dialogue.text: On se calme et on bosse ensemble ?

scenes.image_prompt: Three characters around table, Amel holding phone with Nour Meet logo visible, relaxed atmosphere

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Et moi qui croyais à la guerre…

scenes.image_prompt: Lina laughing, Tarek smiling back, empty plates and shared dessert on table
scenes.motion_prompt: Lina slaps forehead then laughs, Tarek gives thumbs up, dessert sparkles

scenes.image_prompt: Tarek and Lina shaking hands over table, Amel watching satisfied, warm restaurant lights

dialogue.speaker: amel
dialogue.text: C’est comme ça que les vrais deals naissent.

scenes.image_prompt: Close-up on Amel raising glass, soft smile, elegant restaurant decor
scenes.motion_prompt: Amel raises glass slowly then winks, golden particles around glass

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Prochain coup, on vérifie avant de s’énerver.

scenes.image_prompt: Lina looking at camera with knowing smile, Tarek and Amel blurred in background

scenes.vo: Moral : un malentendu pro peut cacher la meilleure alliance. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
